EventEmitter: An emitter of named events to which listener functions can be attached, closely mirroring Node.js's `EventEmitter`.
EventEmitter.addListener: Add `fn` as a listener for `name`, called on every subsequent emit. Returns `this` for chaining.
EventEmitter.addOnceListener: Add `fn` as a listener for `name` that is removed after it fires once. Returns `this` for chaining.
EventEmitter.prependListener: Like `addListener`, but adds `fn` to the beginning of the listener list instead of the end.
EventEmitter.prependOnceListener: Like `addOnceListener`, but adds `fn` to the beginning of the listener list instead of the end.
EventEmitter.removeListener: Remove one instance of `fn` from the listeners for `name`. Returns `this` for chaining.
EventEmitter.removeAllListeners: Remove all listeners, or only those for `name` if given. Returns `this` for chaining.
EventEmitter.emit: Synchronously call each listener registered for `name`, in registration order, with `args`. Returns `true` if there were listeners, `false` otherwise. Emitting `'error'` with no `'error'` listeners throws the error asynchronously instead of calling any listener.
EventEmitter.listeners: Return a copy of the listener array for `name`.
EventEmitter.rawListeners: Return a copy of the listener array for `name`, including one-time wrapper listeners as registered.
EventEmitter.eventNames: Return an array of the event names that currently have listeners.
EventEmitter.listenerCount: Return the number of listeners registered for `name`.
EventEmitter.defaultMaxListeners: The default max-listeners value used by `getMaxListeners()`.
EventEmitter.forward: Forward events named in `names` from `from` to `to`, re-emitting them on `to` only while `to` has at least one listener for that event.
EventEmitterError: The error class used for emitter-internal errors, such as an unhandled `'error'` event or an aborted `events.on`/`events.once` wait.
EventEmitterError.OPERATION_ABORTED: Create an `EventEmitterError` wrapping `cause`, used when an `AbortSignal` aborts a pending `events.on` or `events.once` wait.
EventEmitterError.UNHANDLED_ERROR: Create an `EventEmitterError` wrapping `cause`, used when an `'error'` event is emitted with no listeners attached.
